title: 第185章 两人感染丧尸病毒，却只有一份血清
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赤脚站在屏幕上的双马尾少女，赤色狐狸面具的眼睛正随着小货车和小轿车移动。

小轿车死死咬着小货车，而小轿车同样也被身后的23头猎人丧尸咬着。

白毛双马尾少女双手俏皮地张开，指尖弯起勾着可爱的弧度。

她直接在屏幕顶端从右边蹦跳到左边，就好像在玩跳房子。

白色的双马尾跟着她跳动的身体一颠一颠的。

少女边跳边碎碎念起来，语气调皮又欠揍：

“有意思起来了捏~！”

“两个感染了丧尸病毒的玩家，一个是出生入死的手足兄弟，一个是救过自己一命的可爱女友...”

“但很可惜呢~，只有一根丧尸病毒血清哦~！”

白毛双马尾少女蹦跶到了屏幕的最左边。

她蹲了下来，双手托着下巴，涂着粉色指甲油的脚趾头微微扣着屏幕边缘。

狐狸面具的眼洞里，那双粉色蝴蝶瞳孔，正盯快要到达终点的小货车和小轿车。

少女轻快地哼了两声：

“哼哼~！最后得救的...会是谁呢？”

“好期待啊！好精彩啊！太有乐子了！哈哈哈哈哈！！！”

少女笑着笑着，忽然装作惊讶地捂住面具上的狐狸嘴巴：

“哎呀呀~！人家已经感受到了体内观众大大们的怒气了呢！”

“这么凶啊，都要冲出来打人家了捏~！”

“不过...你们越气，我攻击力越高哦！嘿嘿！”

狐狸面具下，少女嘴角翘起，脸颊微微泛红。

她很兴奋，将双手摆出喇叭状，放在狐狸面具的嘴巴前，然后像头小狼崽那样，仰头发出一声奶萌奶萌的嚎叫：

“嗷呜呜呜~~！！”

“加油啊！开小货车的大哥哥！！”

“干巴爹！！！”

小货车里。

咬着牙的顾屿根本听不到双马尾少女的喊话。

哪怕他驾驶着小货车经过少女，也没听到少女的奶龙咆哮。

可哪怕顾屿真的听到，也都没心情搭理。

此刻的顾屿直接化身秋名山车神。

小货车擦着护栏过弯，刮出一串火星。

他眼里只有终点那支血清。

谁挡谁死！

顾屿将油门直接踩到底，转弯都不减速了。

他那握着方向盘的手不断发力，青筋都突了起来，左手臂的血液几乎凝住，里面还嵌着玻璃碎片，顾屿压根没时间拔出。

顾屿的注意力全在路况上，一句话都不说了。

他的眼球在疯狂转动，大脑不断分析着路况，分析着哪里会突然窜出一头猎人丧尸。

顾屿脸上毫无表情，也没有笑容。

开过车的老司机都知道，当一个男人将油门焊死，且不说话时，他在这一刻就是车神！

当然这种情况，一般只出现在男人车上有即将生产的孕妇，或者有着急送医的病人。

李沐晴坐在副驾驶，一直睁大眼睛看着顾屿。

李沐晴感觉自己脑袋昏昏沉沉的，就像发高烧那样，浑身冰冷，眼皮也很重，很想就这么睡过去。

她张了张嘴，除了轻微的低吼声后，就只能发出几个音节：

“屿.....”

“屿...”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A girl with twin tails standing barefoot on the screen, her eyes in a red fox mask moving with the minivan and car.

The car was biting the small truck, and the car was also bitten by the 23 hunter zombies behind it.

The girl with white hair and double ponytails opened her hands playfully, and her fingertips were curved in a cute arc.

She jumped from right to left directly at the top of the screen, as if playing hopscotch.

The white twin ponytails bounced up and down with her beating body.

少女边跳边碎碎念起来，语气调皮又欠揍：

“有意思起来了捏~！”

“两个感染了丧尸病毒的玩家，一个是出生入死的手足兄弟，一个是救过自己一命的可爱女友...”

“但很可惜呢~，只有一根丧尸病毒血清哦~！”

白毛双马尾少女蹦跶到了屏幕的最左边。

She squatted down, supporting her chin with her hands, and her toes painted with pink nail polish slightly clasped the edge of the screen.

In the eye holes of the fox mask, those pink butterfly pupils were staring at the minivans and cars that were about to reach the finish line.

The girl hummed lightly:

"Hmph~! Who will be saved in the end...?"

"I'm so looking forward to it! It's so exciting! It's so much fun! Hahahahaha!!!"

The girl smiled and suddenly covered the fox's mouth on the mask pretending to be surprised:

"Ouch~! I can already feel the anger of the audience inside my body!"

"You're so fierce, you're going to rush out and beat someone~!"

"But...the angrier you are, the higher my attack power will be! Hehe!"

Under the fox mask, the corners of the girl's mouth were raised and her cheeks were slightly red.

She was very excited. She put her hands in a trumpet shape and placed them in front of the fox mask's mouth. Then, like a wolf cub, she raised her head and let out a cute howl:

"Awwww~~!!"

"Come on! Brother who drives a minivan!!"

"Daddy!!!"

In the pickup truck.

Gu Yu, who was gritting his teeth, couldn't hear the shouts of the girl with twin tails.

Even though he drove a pickup truck past the girl, he didn't hear the girl's milk dragon roar.

But even if Gu Yu really heard it, he was in no mood to pay attention.

At this moment, Gu Yu directly transformed into the Qiu Ming Mountain Car God.

The pickup truck scraped against the guardrail as it turned, creating a trail of sparks.

He only has eyes for the serum at the end.

Whoever stands in his way will die!

Gu Yu stepped on the accelerator to the bottom and didn't even slow down when turning.

His hand holding the steering wheel kept exerting force, and the veins popped out. The blood in his left arm almost froze, and there were shards of glass embedded in it. Gu Yu had no time to pull it out.

Gu Yu's attention was entirely on the road conditions and he didn't say a word.

His eyes were moving wildly, and his brain was constantly analyzing the road conditions and analyzing where a hunter zombie would suddenly appear.

Gu Yu had no expression on his face and no smile.

Experienced drivers who have driven a car know that when a man welds the accelerator to death and doesn't say a word, he is the god of the car at that moment!

Of course, this situation usually only occurs when a man's car contains a pregnant woman who is about to give birth, or a patient who is urgently sent to the hospital.

Li Muqing sat in the passenger seat and kept looking at Gu Yu with wide eyes.

Li Muqing felt that her head was dizzy, as if she had a high fever, her whole body was cold, her eyelids were heavy, and she wanted to just fall asleep.

She opened her mouth, and apart from a slight growl, she could only utter a few syllables:

"Island..."

"Island..."
